**BLUF:** Russian forces launched 108 drones (including jet-powered Shahed variants) against Ukraine overnight 13-14 September, with Ukrainian air defences claiming 85 interceptions; frontline fighting continued with 208 engagements and incremental Russian advances in Kharkiv and Donetsk regions. Oil prices spiked to $109 after Saudi Arabia closed a key export pipeline amid ongoing Hormuz and Red Sea disruptions tied to Houthi gains. Taiwan recorded baseline PLA activity (4 aircraft, 8 ships) while beginning operational testing of US MQ-9B drones; North Korea publicly confirmed its 12 September missile/drone/artillery drill. No verified escalations in other theatres or domains during the window.[[1]](https://newsukraine.rbc.ua/news/russia-attacks-ukraine-with-108-drones-including-1789367576.html)

## 1. STANDING THEATRE SWEEP

### EUROPE / RUSSIA-UKRAINE
- [OSINT - WEB] RBC-Ukraine (14 Sep 2026, ~06:32 UTC) reported Russia launched 108 attack UAVs (Shahed-type including jet-powered, Gerbera, Parodiya decoys) overnight from multiple directions; Ukrainian forces downed or suppressed 85 as of 08:00 local. The attack was ongoing at reporting, with shelter advisories issued.[[1]](https://newsukraine.rbc.ua/news/russia-attacks-ukraine-with-108-drones-including-1789367576.html)
- [OSINT - WEB] Ukrinform / Ukrainian General Staff (14 Sep 2026, 05:57 UTC) reported 208 combat engagements on 13 September, including 90 Russian airstrikes and heavy use of kamikaze drones and artillery; Russian forces advanced in Kharkiv (liberating Shirokoe and Shevchenkovo) and Donetsk directions.[[2]](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4163869-war-update-208-combat-engagements-on-frontline-over-past-day.html)
- [OSINT - WEB] Izvestia (14 Sep 2026) detailed Russian “North” and “Vostok” group advances and claimed Ukrainian losses exceeding 460 personnel plus equipment in Kharkiv and Donetsk sectors.[[3]](https://iz.ru/en/2166648/2026-09-14/map-special-operation-ukraine-september-14)

**Assessment:** The overnight drone wave continues the pattern of sustained Russian pressure on Ukrainian rear areas ahead of winter; Ukrainian defences are intercepting the majority but the introduction of more jet-powered variants increases the challenge. Frontline incremental gains favour Russia in the east but remain attritional rather than decisive.

### MIDDLE EAST
- [OSINT - WEB] Financial Times (14 Sep 2026) reported oil prices reached $109 per barrel after Saudi Arabia closed a vital export pipeline; Riyadh withdrew from regional de-escalation talks on the Strait of Hormuz following a recent drone attack.[[4]](https://www.ft.com/middle-east-north-africa)
- [OSINT - WEB] Pittsburgh Post-Gazette / multiple outlets (14 Sep 2026) reported Houthi forces seized Greater and Lesser Hanish islands in the southern Red Sea, further consolidating control over shipping routes.[[5]](https://www.post-gazette.com/news/world/2026/09/14/middle-east-latest-today-september-14-2026/stories/202609140024)
- [OSINT - WEB] Arab News / Reuters (14 Sep 2026) noted Israeli strikes in Gaza and southern Lebanon causing casualties; separate reports of an ammonia leak in Iraq and postponed Iran-Gulf Hormuz talks.[[5]](https://www.post-gazette.com/news/world/2026/09/14/middle-east-latest-today-september-14-2026/stories/202609140024)

**Assessment:** Energy-market and chokepoint pressure is intensifying from combined Houthi Red Sea gains and Hormuz frictions; Saudi pipeline closure directly tightens supply and raises prices, improving leverage for Iran-aligned actors while increasing costs for global consumers and shipping.

### INDO-PACIFIC
- [OSINT - WEB] Taiwan News (14 Sep 2026, 10:18 local) reported Taiwan’s MND tracked 4 Chinese military aircraft (2 entering ADIZ) and 8 naval/official ships in the 24-hour period ending 06:00 Monday; standard monitoring response deployed.[[6]](https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/6439040)
- [OSINT - WEB] Army Recognition / CNA (14 Sep 2026) reported Taiwan began flight tests of its first two US MQ-9B SkyGuardian UAVs at Hualien for expanded maritime surveillance.[[7]](https://www.armyrecognition.com/news/aerospace-news/2026/taiwan-tests-u-s-mq-9b-drones-to-expand-surveillance-of-chinese-naval-activity-around-island)
- [OSINT - WEB] The Diplomat / KCNA (14 Sep 2026) confirmed North Korea’s 12 September ballistic missile launches were part of a joint firepower drill involving drones, cruise missiles, rocket launchers and tactical ballistic missiles.[[8]](https://thediplomat.com/2026/09/north-korea-confirms-september-12-missile-launch-was-joint-firepower-drill/)

**Assessment:** PLA activity remains at routine levels with no surge; Taiwan’s MQ-9B integration improves persistent ISR against naval threats. North Korea’s delayed public confirmation frames the launch as integrated training rather than a new escalation, keeping tensions calibrated.

### SOUTH AND CENTRAL ASIA
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

### AFRICA
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

### AMERICAS
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

### STRATEGIC AND SPACE
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

### ECONOMIC AND ENERGY PRESSURE
Covered under Middle East and Russia-Ukraine above; no additional chokepoint or sanctions shocks verified in window.

## 2. TECHNOLOGY AND CYBERSECURITY
Quiet in window. No verifiable active exploitation, state-linked intrusions or regulatory actions with identified victims or actors.

## 3. HOMELAND AND INFRASTRUCTURE
Quiet in window. No verifiable incidents affecting civil aviation, rail, ports, power, water or telecoms.

**Assessment (Sections 2–3):** Absence of reported incidents supports a stable baseline; collection focus should remain on any cross-domain indicators linking the active theatres (e.g., cyber support to kinetic operations).

**INDICATORS AND WARNINGS**
- Further Russian jet-powered drone surges or successful strikes on Ukrainian energy → sustained winter pressure and potential NATO response discussions → first visible in Ukrainian Air Force or General Staff daily reports.
- Houthi or Iranian-linked action closing or further restricting Bab el-Mandeb/Hormuz transit → sharp insurance spikes and additional Suez rerouting → first in Lloyd’s List or Kpler shipping data.
- PLA aircraft or naval concentration east of Taiwan exceeding ~15–20 platforms → possible blockade testing → first in Taiwan MND daily report.
- Independent confirmation of damage/casualties from Ukrainian refinery strikes or new Russian industrial hits inside Russia → likely retaliation cycle → first in regional Ukrainian or Russian oblast reporting.

**COLLECTION GAPS**
- Exact damage, casualties and attribution for any unreported Ukrainian deep strikes on Russian refineries or logistics nodes.
- Full scope of Houthi control over recently seized Red Sea islands and immediate effects on specific vessel transits or Saudi/coalition responses.
- Verification of any unreported posture changes or incidents in quiet theatres (South/Central Asia, Africa, Americas, strategic/space, cyber).
